notes: two sayings in one report: Ibn Abbas's answer on exchange («فقال أيدا بيد», asked by Abu Nadra) and Abu Sa'id's account of the Prophet's words; the chain written here is the Prophet's saying, which runs through Abu Sa'id, so Ibn Abbas is not a link of it
the remark «قال أوقال ذلك إنا سنكتب إليه» is in the scene and is left out
